text:
kim: quick flag - our dashboard shows p50/p95/p99 for /v1/embeddings jumping. p50 steady but p99 spikes sporadically.
noah: are we sure it's not low-sample noise? can you paste the sample_count?
kim: merged widget shows sample_count=240 but when I split by route, route=partner-proxy bucket has sample_count=8 and p99=2.4s.
arthur: that explains it. merged percentiles hide tiny heavy tails. we should expose sample_count per-bucket in the UI.
console-team: agree. proposed UI: tiny "split" chevron that expands rows by route/provenance and shows p50/p95/p99 + sample_count. default collapsed.
noah: backend needs to support keep_dimensions=route,provenance on rollup query. current rollup drops those labels to reduce cardinality.
arthur: also recommend alerts check p99_sample_count >= 50 before firing. otherwise on-call gets paged for a handful of outliers.
kim: simple reproduce command for folks:
```
curl -s "https://telemetry.internal/rollups?endpoint=/v1/embeddings&since=10m&group_by=route,provenance" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TELEMETRY" | jq '.[] | {route,provenance,p99,sample_count}'
```
console-team: we'll take the front-end. will add microcopy: "Low sample counts can make percentiles noisy."
ops-bot: noted. suppressing p99 alert if sample_count < 50 for next 24h as a canary.
noah: Thanks, team. let's keep merged view default but make split easy to reach.
